About Us

Our Story

Empowering Irvington through education, community, and top-tier cannabis.

  • Minority-Women Owned
  • Irvington, NJ

The Mission

Springfield Ave Dispensary is proud to be a minority-women owned business rooted right here in Irvington, NJ. We saw a need in our community for a safe, elevated, and educational recreational cannabis experience — so we built it.

Springfield Ave Dispensary Irvington, NJ 07111

Our shelves carry the widest variety of premium recreational cannabis products, but our real differentiator is our approach. We empower our customers with knowledge. We demystify cannabis, breaking down terpenes, cannabinoids, and consumption methods so you always leave confident in your purchase.

Dispensary near me? We're located at 1070 Springfield Ave Suite C, Irvington, NJ 07111. Serving Newark, East Orange, Orange, Maplewood & Essex County. 420 deals updated weekly.

Rooted in Irvington

Springfield Ave Dispensary was founded by minority women who saw their community deserved better — a safe, elevated cannabis experience led by people who actually live here. We invest in Irvington, hire locally, and lead with education every single day.

Why Us

Core Pillars

  • Premium Quality

    We strictly vet every grower and producer. If it's on our menu, it meets our rigid standards for potency and purity.

  • Community First

    We hire locally, support local initiatives, and keep our revenue circulating within the community we serve.

  • Judgment Free

    Everyone's wellness journey is unique. Our environment is welcoming, inclusive, and entirely stigma-free.

  • Expert Guidance

    Our staff is rigorously trained on cannabis science to provide personalized recommendations that actually work.
